notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.10.45 – The Foundations Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes: v0.4.10.45 – The Foundations Update


Hello everyone!

This patch marks an important milestone for our Steam Playtest: it lays down the foundations for accessibility, clarity, and smoother multiplayer battles.



With a brand-new tutorial, improved UI elements, and tons of bug fixes, this update is all about making the game more approachable while polishing the core RTS, deckbuilding and auto battler experience.
[hr][/hr]New Features

Tutorial Map
Finally here: a dedicated tutorial map to introduce new players to the basics of the game. Perfect for newcomers and a great refresher for veterans.


Player Rank Icons
Lobby and player lists now show rank icons for each player, adding flair and making progression more visible.


Level Cap Notification
At the end of each match, you’ll now see whether you’ve reached the maximum level. 👉 For this Playtest, the cap is set to Level 5.
[hr][/hr]

Improvements
Bases are easier to tell apart with improved color coding.

Team recognition improved thanks to reworked spawners.

Base capture is now clearly displayed with a percentage bar and instant update notifications.

Finished base captures are more visually impactful.

Multiplayer maps updated with rebalanced player starting positions.

MiniMap pings are now much more noticeable.

Help window reworked for better accessibility.

Loading screen redesigned and now includes useful gameplay tips.

Sharper text across the board for better readability.

All text input fields now support extended functionality.
[hr][/hr]

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where destroyed building plots couldn’t be reused.

Fixed an issue where newly spawned units would occasionally ignore collision with a unit standing directly in front of the spawner, causing overlap/passing through.

Supply drops with rockets/missiles sometimes ignored helicopters ==> corrected.

Vehicles now drive at the correct speed in all situations.

Fixed vehicles stopping despite having space to move.

Steam Card corrections.

Fixed fullscreen-only startup issue.

Cursor now resets properly.

Fixed failed login attempt issue.

Server list bugs corrected.

Lobby crash fixed when a player was kicked.

Dozens of smaller fixes and polish passes.
[hr][/hr]

Community Thanks
A huge thank you to everyone participating in the Playtest and sharing feedback – especially regarding the new Tutorial. Your input is invaluable and helps us make the game more accessible and enjoyable for both new and veteran commanders. [img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/economy/emoticon/steamthumbsup"]
[hr][/hr]




See you on the battlefield,

General Front

notes.title: Patchlog: v0.4.10.40
notes.content:
🚁 Patch Notes: Air Cavalry Update – All Helicopters Ready for Action!




Hello everyone! 👋



The sky is yours now!
The long-awaited helicopter update is finally live in the Steam Playtest.
After several dev logs and early previews, this patch brings all the announced light, medium, and heavy helicopter units into the game – including 15 brand-new player cards!



It’s the biggest content update since the start of the Playtest – and it fundamentally changes the battlefield.


[hr][/hr]

🛩️ New Helicopter Units: Full Deployment
✅ All previously revealed light helicopters are now fully playable.
✈️ Medium and heavy air support units have been added, focused on firepower, armor, and special abilities.
🧠 NPCs now actively use helicopters for both defense and offense – be ready for anything!

⚖️ Each helicopter type brings unique advantages:

Light: Very fast and agile – perfect for precise, hit-and-run tactics

Medium: Versatile with strong firepower

Heavy: Slow but extremely durable – ideal for breaking enemy lines


[hr][/hr]

🃏 15 New Player Cards in the Deck Builder
With this update, 15 brand-new helicopter cards are now available in the deck builder.

Rarities range from Common to Epic

All cards are available immediately in the Playtest

Expand your air strategy and create new deck synergies


[hr][/hr]

⚙️ Improvements
General performance optimizations

Life indicators are now drawn directly

Improved readability of small text on cards


[hr][/hr]

🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed a rare bug when opening the codex

Multiple minor issues resolved:

Corrected card stack display

Fixed game time and resource display

Improved text alignment in the chat input field

Fixed HP/DPS value display on cards

Corrected error message formatting in the deck builder

Fixed a rare end-of-map crash

Fixed a targeting system bug that caused certain weapons not to fire


[hr][/hr]


See you on the battlefield,
General Front

notes.title: Patchlog: v0.4.9.38
notes.content:
Improvements:

 Optimized text rendering across all areas.
 Increased the amount of certain loot rewards from booster packs and level-ups.
 Increased the number of booster credits granted upon leveling up.
 Rewards from booster packs and level-ups are now categorized from Common to Epic, making it easier to recognize whether a reward is high or low.
 Improved the display of the Steam card.
 Various minor UI improvements.


Bugfixes:

 Fixed an issue where the number of available mission plans was displayed incorrectly after rerolling a mission.
 Replaced all in-game fonts with Unicode-compatible versions. The game now correctly handles usernames containing non-Latin characters. As a result, the workaround from 2025-05-25 is no longer necessary.
 Fixed an issue where the ping indicator was not shown in the lobby.

notes.title: v0.4.9.37
notes.content:
- Bugfix & Workaround: Users with non-Latin characters in their Steam name can now join the server. Their name will temporarily be changed to "nobody...".
- Performance & Stability: Improved server performance and stability.
- Feature in Development: Progress on the new Card Upgrade System.

notes.title: Hotfix!
notes.content:
- The quick start tutorial was not displayed correctly.
- Some missing translations have been added.
- Minor balance adjustments have been made.
- A bug in the lobby that delayed the start of the match has been fixed.

notes.title: Bugfixes & Improvements: v0.4.9.36
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the game client could occasionally crash during the initial connection phase.

- Server connections at game start now tolerate slightly higher ping values. Previously, only near-perfect ping connections were accepted.
Note: We're still welcoming feedback on connection quality to help improve the infrastructure for the upcoming Early Access.

- Improved the readability of card texts (adjustments to font sizes, contrast, and layout).
